text:
mia: Quick ask — post-launch benchmark assets bundle for QS1 inbound push. Need: 1) hero webinar slide (16:9) 2) three social tiles (1:1) 3) benchmark one-pager (A4) 4) short GIF tease (1080x1080) 5) lead-routing callout image for LP. Goal: cohesive visuals, brand-safe, and accessible. Delivery target: Tue EOD. @design please advise availability.

leo: On it. Can you confirm primary stat + two headline options so comps don't drift?

mia: Primary stat = "40% lower per-token cost" (validated by Optimize bench). Headline options: 1) "Serving wins: cut inference $/token" 2) "More throughput, less spend". Short tile copy: "Predictable inference. Lower unit cost." CTA: "Register" for webinar / "Learn more" for web.

jane: Legal note — avoid standalone % claims without context. Suggested support copy: "Based on Redwood Optimize internal benchmarking; typical workloads saw up to 40% reduction vs baseline." Use that as tooltip/footnote on one-pager. Whitelist logos only from /assets/logos/partners/verified. Figma source: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/qs1-bench-pack (permission: marketing-view).

leo: Got it. Dark and light variants needed? Also preferred aspect/color for GIF?

mia: Primary palette = dark slate background + amber CTA. Social tiles also need white-background alternate. GIF should be 1080x1080, loop ~3s, max 2MB, simple sparkline -> stat -> CTA. Include alt text for accessibility.

sam: Lead-routing spec for forms/LP: add hidden UTMs: `utm_source=qs1`, `utm_campaign=benchlaunch`, `utm_medium=social`. Lead mapping: campaign=QS1-BENCH, interest_tag=benchmarking, route -> SDR queue `bench-q1`. File name / size guidance: hero_16x9.jpg (1920x1080), tile_1x1.gif (1080x1080), onepager_pdf.pdf (A4 2480x3508 px). Also please export a 600px-wide fallback for email.

designbot: Generated checklist/template: 1) comps in Figma page "Bench-QS1/Comps" 2) export PNG @2x and SVG where appropriate 3) run WCAG color-contrast check (auto report attached in Figma comments) 4) add alt text strings in component metadata 5) name files per `brand_bench_qs1_<asset>_<variant>.<ext>`. Template link: https://assets.redwood.internal/templates/bench-qs1 (internal).

leo: I'll mock hero + 3 social tiles first, push to Figma Friday AM, include dark/light + GIF frame slices. I'll follow naming and export checklist.

mia: Perfect. Prioritize hero + social tiles. Quick review sync Fri 10:00am PT — I'll send calendar invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jane: Adding legal/brand reviewer @elaine to the invite.

sam: Noted — once final assets exported I'll validate file names and drop them into staging LP.

leo: Cool, ping me here for any copy tweaks.

mia: Closing loop — thanks team, excited to get these live.
